channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: More than two hundred livestock farms in Vermont and New Hampshire will get help with conservation planning. A six point four million dollar grant supports this effort. The program promotes sustainable farming practices.

Stafford Technical Center plans to cut over five hundred thousand dollars from its budget due to a tuition increase cap. Two staff positions will be eliminated, and secretarial days reduced. The proposed tuition rate is twenty-four thousand one hundred one dollars per student for fiscal year twenty-twenty-eight.

Silloway Maple of Cornwall Vermont was honored at the Vermont Maple Sugar Makers' annual awards. A brother and sister team from Randolph also received recognition. The event celebrates excellence in maple syrup production.

Addison Central School District plans to consider cutting ten jobs to meet budget limits. The board will identify which positions on November thirty. This is part of an austerity plan for the twenty twenty-eight fiscal year.
